verdicts.reason: A: the 'Wild Honey' and 'Rosemary' pills are cut off from the group and pushed to the far left and right edges. The logo floats awkwardly between the jar and the headline. The CTA has been shrunk into a chip that looks like one of the pills. The fine print 'Flavours vary by region' is blown up to the size of a subhead. B: it repeats several of these flaws. Rosemary is stranded alone on the right, the CTA sits in the pill row at pill size, and the disclaimer is oversized. On top of that, 'Wild Honey' is shrunk to an illegible micro-pill. Still, B reads more cleanly from left to right (logo, jar, then copy) and keeps four of the five ingredients grouped, so it is marginally less broken.
